title: Siege of Oshi
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Oshi", at revision 1370744223, opens: "The 1590 siege of Oshi  was one of many battles in Toyotomi Hideyoshi's campaigns against the Hōjō clan during Japan's Sengoku period." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q15663170, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1590 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
